data.raw_text:
DA WHO????

Always present for the cameras, but suddenly deaf and blind when disaster strikes?

Navotas is choking on toxic smoke, but where is Toby Tiangco? Busy doing PR stunts and media interviews instead of saving his own city. While his constituents suffocate and suffer, he is working overtime to save his image. But no amount of press releases can wash off the stench of his administrative disaster.

Let us stop pointing fingers elsewhere. The Tiangco brothers, Toby and John Rey, have been playing musical chairs with the mayoral and congressional seats since the year 2000. They are the absolute rulers of Navotas, which means they own every single failure of the local government. There is no one else to blame because no one else has been in charge.

They literally opened the gates to this inferno. Under Toby from 2000 to 2010, the city institutionalized its dependence on PhilEco for waste management. When John Rey took over from 2010 to 2019, he turned Navotas into the ultimate garbage dump of Metro Manila. Instead of enforcing environmental safeguards and monitoring the methane build up, they let the mountain of trash grow into a ticking time bomb.

When Toby returned from 2019 to 2022, what did he do? Absolutely nothing. They should have planned the safe closure of the facility, but they slept on the job and wasted the opportunity. Now that John Rey is back in the hot seat, the crisis has fully exploded after the permit expired in 2025. This fire is not an accident. It is a brutal consequence of gross negligence born from zero planning and zero coordination.

You can never separate the brothers from this catastrophe. Toby built and enabled the rotten system, while John Rey managed its disastrous peak. The tragedy suffocating Navotas right now is not a mistake from a single term. It is the direct result of more than two decades of pure negligence. This is a massive systemic failure, and they cooked it right in their very own backyard.
